lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection, live wait countdown timers, and personality-driven or refreshed path headlines consistently won.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, path duration hints, and photo processing hints won, whereas account recovery hints hurt and many other hints showed no clear effect.
Specific split-layout redesigns (photo upload, wait screen) and select desktop control guide screens won, while sub-flows, trait selectors, and major redesigns hurt or showed no clear effect.

Reordering sign-in after photo upload, desktop companion story copy, and estimated time headlines hurt performance; audio chimes, notifications, adoption badges, and incentive callouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, post-photo sign-in reordering, and major layout redesigns.
Predictions underestimated gains for targeted hints, personality headlines, live wait timers, and effective control guide screens.

candidates.title: Multi-Device Pet Sync Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Displays a hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in safely binds their pets to their account so existing pets are restored on any device.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in syncs your account pet collection so your companions are safely preserved across logins.

guard.reason: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen explaining multi-device account pet sync within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeted persistence hints consistently win and are backed by strong email evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Overview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen right before the final home welcome screen detailing how to hide, wake, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 tickets about user confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding.

new_controls_overview.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Companion
new_controls_overview.body: Access your desktop taskbar icon to quick-toggle visibility, wake your pet, or open interaction controls.

guard.reason: Adds a new controls overview screen before home intro, which is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New screens at finish step historically hurt conversion despite support interest.

candidates.title: Companion Path Stage Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose path selection screen into a step-focused stage layout.
candidates.why: Path choice step has high mean duration (514s); layout clarity helps users pick quickly.

guard.reason: Redesigns the path selection screen layout while maintaining its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Major layout redesigns carry low historical success and tend to overestimate gains.

candidates.title: Pet Choice Stage View Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuilds the pick friend screen using a stage layout with a step counter indicator.
candidates.why: Adoption step has an 80% conversion rate and median 89s completion time; structured stage layout improves adoption speed.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pick friend screen layout with a stage view and step counter.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have averaged -1.5% in previous tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Desktop Arrival Progress Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit status copy on the waiting screen explaining that the custom pet is rendering and will automatically pop up on the desktop when finished.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not displaying on the desktop and 3 emails about custom generation glitches.

waiting.hint: Your companion is rendering in the background and will automatically launch onto your desktop once ready.

guard.reason: Adds arrival progress hint copy to the waiting screen, which is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Progress hints address clear support complaints and align with wait timer wins.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In Immediately After Path Selection
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in screen immediately after the path choice step before pet customization begins.
candidates.why: Securing account creation upfront prevents account loss issues reported in 8 support emails.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in to occur right after path selection, which is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in right after path selection is a proven winning pattern.

candidates.title: Photo Generation Accuracy Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen explaining photo quality requirements for accurate 3D pet rendering.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visual results.

upload_photos.hint: Clear, well-lit photos ensure your custom desktop pet renders accurately without visual artifacts.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo quality guidelines on the upload screen without altering rules.

candidates.score_note: Photo processing hints consistently win with minimal implementation cost.

candidates.title: Home Welcome Centered Controls Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a centered layout with an added quick controls summary component.
candidates.why: The final step takes mean 5815s with 76.3% completion, and users frequently ask how to operate desktop controls.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen layout and adds a quick controls summary component.

candidates.score_note: Desktop control guides help, but finish redesigns generally drag conversion.

candidates.title: Companion Journey Expected Duration Headline
candidates.change: Updates headlines on the path choice screen to state that path selection takes under 1 minute.
candidates.why: Clear duration expectations reduce user dropoff (currently 11.4% dropoff at choose_path).

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Path (Takes 1 Min)
choose_path.body: Choose how your companion interacts with your desktop to start setup.

guard.reason: Updates headline and body copy on the path choice screen without removing choices or breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Estimated time headlines consistently hurt performance in past tests.

candidates.title: Generation Completion Desktop Notification Switch
candidates.change: Enables readiness notification alerts and live time estimates on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has median 201s duration and 11.8% dropoff.

guard.reason: Enables readiness notifications and a time estimate on the waiting screen for a real wait.

candidates.score_note: Notifications show mild positive effect but lag behind live countdown timers.

picked: Reorder Sign-In Immediately After Path Selection
Desktop Pet Desktop Arrival Progress Hint

decisions.title: Reorder Sign-In Immediately After Path Selection
Desktop Pet Desktop Arrival Progress Hint

shipped: Reorder Sign-In Immediately After Path Selection
lessons_next: Reordering sign-in right after pet or path selection consistently won, but reordering sign-in after photo upload severely hurt performance.

Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, photo processing/accuracy hints, and path duration hints won; account recovery hints hurt, while audio chimes, notifications, and badges showed no clear effect.

Live wait timers, split photo upload/waiting screen redesigns, and centered home control layouts won, whereas desktop launchpad/tray reference redesigns, trait selectors, and sub-flows hurt or showed no clear effect.
Personality-driven and refreshed path selection headlines won, but story copy, photo clarity guidance copy, and estimated time headlines hurt performance.
Desktop control tutorial and quick toggle guide screens won, whereas tray navigation/reference screens, tray icon control screens, and sub-flows hurt or showed no clear effect.

Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, post-photo sign-in reordering, and major layout redesigns, while underestimating targeted hints, live wait timers, and select guide screens/layouts.
